project: Digital Asset Risk Strategy AI Copilot
boundary: Internship-derived personal prototype using synthetic/desensitized structures. No production connection, automatic penalty, automatic regulatory filing, KEP workflow, or Anti-Fraud operations dashboard is included.
company_style_scope: Rule Engine and three-level strategy tags
historical backtest and simulation-state independent evaluation
independent second-person review and version/hash-bound approval
CMS one-click internal STR candidate case and MASAK feedback status
Risk Graph, onboarding plus T+1 user risk scoring, penalty/verification recommendations

architecture.orchestration: native asyncio plus optional LangGraph fan-out/fan-in
architecture.tools: local typed registry plus optional FastMCP facades
architecture.strategy_registry: SQLite atomic version and audit registry

tool_manifest.name: catalog.get_event_contract
tool_manifest.description: Return a versioned event contract with typed feature schemas, actions, lineage warnings, and a reproducible SHA-256 hash.

tool_manifest.name: catalog.list_events
tool_manifest.description: List registered risk events, their domains, allowed actions, and feature availability.

tool_manifest.name: catalog.list_products
tool_manifest.description: List risk-control products reconstructed from weekly internship materials.
tool_manifest.signature: (layer: 'str | None' = None, prototype_status: 'str | None' = None) -> 'list[dict[str, Any]]'

tool_manifest.name: catalog.map_products
tool_manifest.description: Map a risk requirement to relevant products and their dependency closure.

tool_manifest.name: catalog.search_features
tool_manifest.description: Search real-time/offline features by event, domain, tags, or semantic keyword.
tool_manifest.signature: (text: 'str' = '', domain: 'str | None' = None, event_code: 'str | None' = None, tags: 'list[str] | None' = None) -> 'list[dict[str, Any]]'

tool_manifest.name: catalog.validate_contracts
tool_manifest.description: Validate all event/feature references and report blocking errors separately from lineage drift warnings.

tool_manifest.name: catalog.validate_decision_time
tool_manifest.description: Validate that candidate features exist, belong to the event, and are available at decision time.

tool_manifest.name: catalog.write_products
tool_manifest.description: Write the full risk product catalog and product architecture diagram.

tool_manifest.name: data.schema
tool_manifest.description: Return dataset dimensions, columns, dtypes, missingness, and positive-label rate.

tool_manifest.name: features.behavior_contrast
tool_manifest.description: Compare fraud/non-fraud feature distributions and extract interpretable manifestations.

tool_manifest.name: features.profile
tool_manifest.description: Compute missingness, AUC, KS, IV/WOE, Lift@10, Cramer's V, PSI, direction, and recommendation.

tool_manifest.name: governance.create_effectiveness_ticket
tool_manifest.description: Create a Ticket-Module-style strategy-effectiveness label bound to the exact strategy version, test run, and data snapshot.
tool_manifest.signature: (test_plan: 'dict[str, Any] | StrategyTestPlan', metrics, conflict_analysis: 'dict[str, Any] | None' = None, stability_analysis: 'dict[str, Any] | None' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'

tool_manifest.name: governance.evaluate_company_test_environment
tool_manifest.description: Build the company-style FEP/Rule-Engine test plan: feature validation, historical backtest, simulation, independent second review, three-day observation, and effectiveness review.
tool_manifest.signature: (strategy: 'StrategyCandidate', strategy_version: 'int', engine_payload: 'dict[str, Any]', metrics, governance, data_snapshot_id: 'str', feature_catalog_version: 'str', stability_analysis: 'dict[str, Any] | None' = None, conflict_analysis: 'dict[str, Any] | None' = None, ai_advisory_board: 'dict[str, Any] | None' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'

tool_manifest.name: governance.persist_strategy
tool_manifest.description: Persist an AI-assisted strategy candidate, simulation metrics, governance transition, and audit event in SQLite.

tool_manifest.name: governance.plan_disposition
tool_manifest.description: Build the L1-L4 action ladder and penalty/verification-center approval controls.

tool_manifest.name: governance.review_strategy
tool_manifest.description: Apply lifecycle, decision-time, action, metric, approval, and confidentiality gates.

tool_manifest.name: governance.strategy_history
tool_manifest.description: Read all versions, approvals, and audit events for a registered strategy.

tool_manifest.name: graph.enrich_users
tool_manifest.description: Build one-hop/two-hop graph features while down-weighting weak IP relations.

tool_manifest.name: graph.explain_user
tool_manifest.description: Return auditable user-to-identifier-to-user paths and one/two-hop risk features.

tool_manifest.name: integration.prepare_cms_str_candidates
tool_manifest.description: For eligible third-level strategy tags, prefill internal CMS/STR candidate cases with evidence snapshots. This never files or submits externally.

tool_manifest.name: knowledge.build_system
tool_manifest.description: Generate the internship-derived risk-scenario and strategy knowledge map as Markdown and CSV.

tool_manifest.name: knowledge.search
tool_manifest.description: Hybrid lexical/character retrieval over risk scenarios and SOPs.
tool_manifest.signature: (query: 'str', top_k: 'int' = 6, industry: 'str | None' = None, document_type: 'str | None' = None) -> 'list[dict[str, Any]]'

tool_manifest.name: models.extract_tree_rules
tool_manifest.description: Extract high-risk leaves from the depth-4 decision tree into executable rule DSL candidates.

tool_manifest.name: models.global_importance
tool_manifest.description: Return aggregated global feature importance for tree-based models.

tool_manifest.name: models.train_benchmarks
tool_manifest.description: Train time-split Logistic Regression, depth-4 Decision Tree, and XGBoost baselines.

tool_manifest.name: rules.backtest_rank
tool_manifest.description: Backtest all executable candidates and rank them with a multi-objective, GRPO-inspired group-relative reward.

tool_manifest.name: rules.generate_candidates
tool_manifest.description: Generate expert-template, quantile, graph, tree, and model-score candidates.
tool_manifest.signature: (data: 'pd.DataFrame', profiles: 'list', request: 'StrategyRequest', tree_candidates: 'list[StrategyCandidate] | None' = None, trained_models: 'list[TrainedModel] | None' = None) -> 'list[StrategyCandidate]'

tool_manifest.name: rules.prepare_holdout
tool_manifest.description: Create the common development or OOT frame and attach split-specific model scores.

tool_manifest.name: scoring.assess_users
tool_manifest.description: Calculate onboarding and T+1 dynamic risk tiers with explicit manual-override and confidentiality controls.
